title: Himachal Pradesh HC: Enhanced Gratuity Ceiling Runs Only From the Amendment Date
case_name: Retired employees of HIMFED v. Himachal Pradesh State Co-operative Marketing and Consumers Federation
card_summary: Retired HIMFED employees wanted the Rs 20 lakh gratuity ceiling applied from 1 January 2016, citing a state Office Memorandum of 25 February 2022. Justices Ajay Mohan Goel and Yogesh Jaswal held HIMFED's gratuity liability is governed by the central Payment of Gratuity Act, amended only from 29 March 2018, so employees who retired earlier could not claim the enhanced ceiling.
card_tip: Before invoking a state circular to claim an enhanced gratuity ceiling, check whether the employer's actual gratuity liability runs under the central Act rather than state service rules.
verification_notes: Case number (CWP No. 2697 of 2024), decision date (22 September 2026), the bench (Justices Ajay Mohan Goel and Yogesh Jaswal), the central amendment date of 29 March 2018, and the petitioners' reliance on the February 2022 state Office Memorandum are corroborated across LiveLaw and SupremeToday. Named individual petitioners were not confirmed in available reporting and are accordingly described by their status rather than by name.
